title: Render matrix
description: The render matrix, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #102: one component package's rendered copies, fabric by fabric. The fabrics array declares the estate the package must cover — every fabric must carry a render — and each render row cites the version, the pinned sha256 digest, and the policy bindings in force on that fabric. Judged at the render-matrix gate against the component package manifest, as a conformance gate — not an advisor: a render for another component, a fabric with no render, a version or digest disagreeing with the package, a declared binding missing from a fabric, and a binding in force the package never declared are all refused, each citing the fabric and the divergent field. This schema mirrors the shape rules of the Rego validator (policies/matrix); the validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — reviewedOn a real calendar date not in the future and not older than 365 days, fabrics declared and unique, render rows well-formed and one per declared fabric, versions and digests agreeing with the package manifest, and every policy binding agreeing with the package's, in both directions.

version.description: Version of the render matrix. A matrix nobody re-reads is a matrix the fabrics silently left behind.

reviewedOn.description: Date the matrix was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags reviews older than 365 days and dates in the future.

owner.description: The team that owns the matrix. A fabric render with an owner and a review cadence is the discipline.

component.description: The component the matrix renders. Must be the component the package manifest packages — a matrix for another component is a join the gate refuses to judge (gate/component-mismatch).

fabrics.description: The fabrics the package must be rendered to — the N in one component, N fabrics. A component is not deployed until every declared fabric carries a render; a fabric declared twice is a render the gate cannot count.

renders.description: The render rows: one per declared fabric, each the fabric's rendered copy of the package. The gate flags a row citing a fabric the matrix never declared (render/fabric-undeclared), the same fabric rendered twice (render/row-duplicate), a version or digest disagreeing with the package manifest (gate/render-version-skew, gate/render-digest-drift), and policy binding disagreements in both directions (gate/binding-missing, gate/binding-undeclared).

fabric.description: The fabric this row renders onto. Must be declared in fabrics.

version.description: The package version as rendered on this fabric. Must agree with the package manifest.

digest.description: The sha256 digest of the artifact as rendered on this fabric. Must be the digest the package manifest publishes.

bindings.description: The policy bindings in force on this fabric, each a policy and the exact path it renders from. Judged as pairs against the package manifest's policyBindings: a binding the package declared that a fabric never ran drifts silently, and so does a binding in force the package never declared.

policy.description: The policy in force, by name.

path.description: The exact path the policy renders from. A path disagreement is a binding disagreement — the gate compares the pair.
